marcia.name: Marcia Odunsi
marcia.headline: Allotment secretary, 14 yrs. Open to discreet horticulture.
marcia.about: Ran the Brockley allotments through two floods and a hosepipe ban. Knows what grows where, and who's been digging where they shouldn't.

tomasz.name: Tomasz Wójcik
tomasz.headline: Landscaping grad. Hungry. Will learn anything.
tomasz.about: First-class degree, no references yet. Early riser. Owns his own boots and most of a van.

bernie.name: Bernie Kale
bernie.headline: Forty years in the trade. Not here to learn.
bernie.about: Has tended seams under three different owners. Outlasted all of them. Tea, two sugars, no questions.

saoirse.name: Saoirse Flynn
saoirse.headline: Ex-cooperative grower. Left on good terms. Mostly.
saoirse.about: Six years growing for the Collective. Good with the awkward seams. Will tell you about the time she nearly went to Lisbon.

priya.name: Priya Sandhu
priya.headline: Materials engineer, formerly of a firm she won't name.
priya.about: Tolerances, stress loads, and paperwork that never quite mentions what the material was. Signed something. Won't discuss it.

dot.name: Dot Mayhew
dot.headline: Herbalist. Market stall, Deptford.
dot.about: Tinctures, poultices, and a remedy for heartbreak she swears is mostly gin. Saturdays only, unless you're paying.

gideon.name: Gideon Achterberg
gideon.headline: Horologist. Guild-trained. Expensive, and worth it.
gideon.about: Apprenticed in Clerkenwell. Repairs movements most people can't open. Invoices to the minute.

ray.name: Ray Okafor-Bell
ray.headline: Jack of all trades. Ask around.
ray.about: Has done a bit of everything, some of it twice. Turns up. Usually.
